name: mirage
text: I went through that report. Most of it is limits and known issues. Two items are real. (1) Kalshi's 250 'HTTP 400' errors are the 'not enough money' bug from last night: your cash sat in a different Kalshi shard than the market. That was fixed, and a couple of bets went through afterwards. The report's only recent Kalshi failure is a single phone DNS miss 7 minutes ago. (2) Pinnodds and PinnWire: the key is used up for about another 8 hours, which is Pinnodds' own limit, not a bug. The app rests the key and uses other sources. Unabated (free tier) and SharpAPI are slow-down warnings I already pace. They are working as designed. The real findings are #17 and #18. bets.json (10 MB) and light-bids.json (4 MB) are rewritten whole on every change, which causes lag. I'll fix those by keeping recent bets in the fast file and moving old settled bets to an archive. Your Tracker totals won't change. This is task CH83. Tell me if there is something else in that report you want fixed first.
